about: Stock reaction lines, recorded once per tutor and played in any lesson, like callbacks.json (README, "Reactions", GitHub #220). ack plays on a free toy send, or a right build tile with no line of its own. slip plays on the first miss of a toy task, build step or typed answer, and doesn't play again until every other line of its kind in that tutor's set has played this session, and never in place of the not-yet line. No line names a number, a topic or the player's mistake.

ack.speaker: tin-can-tess
ack.say: Yep, out the gate with that one.

ack.speaker: tin-can-tess
ack.say: Bits on the bench, and in it goes.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Whoops, there goes a washer! Straight into the chilly bin, that one.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Back on the bench with that, eh.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Scales tipped my tea over. Should've moved the tea.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Bolt's stripped. Another one for my tin, and the tin's nearly full.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Oof, that sheet of tin's gone all wavy. We'll flatten it out.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Gauges are arguing again. Pay them no mind.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Spanner slipped, and now the shed dog's barking at me.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Heaps of sparks off that one. Pretty, though.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Kia ora, little bolt, where are you rolling off to?

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Little wobble on that. Nothing a hammer won't sort.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Jerry can's glugging all over the floor. Oh well, it's mostly water.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Hang on, that came off in my hand. Anyway, I've got glue.

slip.speaker: tin-can-tess
slip.say: Clattered right off the bench, that did.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Blot right across the takings.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Pencil's snapped. I've got another.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Column won't balance. Line through it and go again.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Smudge on the page. The book's seen worse.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Somebody's about to get billed for a ute they never bought. Fix it before they hear.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Page torn. Tape's in the drawer.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Pit boss has sold the same seat to the whole front row.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Doesn't tally. Not yet.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Fly landed in the ink. Poor thing.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Well, that's a mess. Turn the page.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Hang about. That entry's gone under somebody else's name.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Till's jammed again. Nobody's getting change today.

slip.speaker: mags-the-ledger
slip.say: Cat's asleep on the receipts. I'll work round her.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Static. Come in again.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Eish. That one's gone to the wrong settlement. They'll cope.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Shame. The relay didn't like that.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Hold on. Something's smoking up there. Go again.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: There goes a fuse. I've got spares. Come in again.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Interference. A crow's sitting on the dish again.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Is it? That landed in a goat farmer's kitchen. He sends his regards.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Feedback. My ears are ringing.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Crossed wires somewhere up the mast.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: So the far settlements got the near ones' weather. Bit of rain they weren't expecting.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Quiet on the line. I don't love quiet.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Antenna's leaning a bit. Still works, mostly.

slip.speaker: rook-dead-air
slip.say: Backup battery's kicked in. That's what it's for.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Sorry. The peg has fallen over.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: A dust devil has crossed my sight line. We wait for it to pass.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: The chain has lost a link. I have spares in the bag.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Hmm. The triangle did not close. It happens.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Oil has spilled out of my level. I will clean it later.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: My scope has fogged. Give it a moment.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Somewhere out there, a crew is digging in the wrong place. Let us call them back.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Salt in the lens again. I will wipe it.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Drifted. The Flats do not like to keep still.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Lizard on the peg again. He thinks it is his.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Glare off the salt. Nobody could read that.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Kindly hold still, instrument. Thank you.

slip.speaker: kara-meridian
slip.say: Ah, the plumb line is swinging. Let it settle.

ack.speaker: lucky-lenoir
ack.say: Mm, smooth as a new deck.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: And there goes my hat.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Gum in the wheel again. Who does this?

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: I bet you a cap that I could catch that die. I could not.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Non, non. The cards have blown away.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: My last cap, gone. It was a very good cap.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Under the stall, those dice. They always come back.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Listen to the crowd groan. They love a drama.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Pff. The house takes this little one.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Quel dommage.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Somebody turned the lamp off mid-shuffle. Rude.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Sadly, the wheel spins on without us.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: Even the house did not see that coming.

slip.speaker: lucky-lenoir
slip.say: What a roll. Off the table, but what a roll.

ack.speaker: calc
ack.say: Entry added. Rate of change: positive.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Alert. Coolant pressure rising. Venting.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Warning light active. It is a very small light.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Fault logged. The fault is not alarmed. I am also not alarmed.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Query. Was that a fan? That was a fan. It has stopped.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Valve released. Steam is harmless at this distance.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: No record. Recalculating.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Gauge needle twitched. It does that. Resuming.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Temperature up by a small amount. A small amount is acceptable.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Memory sector corrupted. Restoring from backup.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: A spark has left the panel. It will not be missed.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: The canteen reports a flicker. The canteen always reports a flicker.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Interesting. That reading moved faster than predicted. I would like another.

slip.speaker: calc
slip.say: Alarm silenced. It was a short alarm.
